facts.claim: Tidewell SAS was registered in Paris with Maya Okafor as president.
Tidewell opened its private beta to finance teams from its waitlist.
facts.excerpt: Today we open the Tidewell private beta to the first forty finance teams on our waitlist.

facts.claim: Maya wrote how Tidewell found its first ten design partners and asks how to turn them into a story for investors.
facts.excerpt: Seven came from people I had worked with, three from a single post in a finance community. The harder question now is the next one: how do we turn ten happy users into a story an investor can follow in five minutes?

notes: Writes in English on her notes page; the beta post asks readers to reply, a direct register.
